column1: # Bug yield per landed item: the stopping signal of docs/agents/finish-line-plan.md §1.1. The reviewer appends one row before landing (worker.md, reviewer brief step 4). kind: rulings | roundtrip | audit | mutation | property | judge | gaps. units: what was processed (rulings, mismatching cards, tests written, mutants run, games). Count a bug whatever found it; put the same counts in the landing commit as a `Yield:` line.

column9: reconstructed from commit subjects (reports/finish-line-rulings-pool.md §3), so approximate; 5 batches had no fix

column4: 178 equivalence rules and forms read (164 rules, 12 sentence forms, 2 ignored words), 92 docs' Remaining/deviation passages swept (14 re-read by the review), 68 ruling texts reconciled (45 excluded, 23 exemption differences)
column9: the one compiler fix is the grandeur cost compiled as the printed name (Spy Kit could pay it; found by reading the equivalence list); the parser's conflation of "the next upkeep" and "the next turn's upkeep" (Paradox Haze) is handed to roundtrip-pairs-N/gaps-residual-2; no unregistered reading found (128 entries, 0 provisional); the two rulings counts now agree, with a test

hate-attacker batch; engine bugs: 'whenever a player attacks' fired only for the active player (CR 508.3d/e, 805.10), a targeting restriction's equipped creature read the current attachment (CR 113.7a, Plasma Caster), a 'can't be the target' restriction about permanents hit spells (CR 109.2, Autumn's Veil); test errors: 32 tests with CR citations their assertions don't exercise, 1 test whose assertions held whichever way the ruling went (Outrider en-Kor); 1 provisional register entry added in review

both bugs found in review among the 62 Remaining cards: Rakdos, the Showstopper destroyed the creatures one flip at a time instead of all at once (CR 608.2f, compiler), Counterbalance could choose to reveal from an empty library and counter a mana-value-0 spell (CR 608.2d, engine); test error: Tinybones cited 608.2b for a check made as the effect is applied (608.2h); also fixed in review: a renderer alternative the AST doesn't mean and 4 wrong CR numbers in renderer comments

mana-value batch ("scales with mana value"); compiler fix: "those cards" after a batched leave-graveyard trigger named the batch (Amzu, Swarm's Hunger counted the mana value of its own token); engine bug (found in review): the targets of a multi-target spell or ability were not chosen as a set (CR 601.2c, 603.3d): a first target with no legal partner for a later dependent instance of "target" was offered and asked for (Puca's Mischief with no legal pair prompted for a first target, then removed the trigger); test errors: 11 tests citing rules their assertions don't exercise, 2 assertions that held whichever way the ruling went (Birthing Ritual's untouched library, Puca's prompt); no exemptions, no register entries

row added by the rulings-P154 review (the landing had none); 141 of the batch's 150 texts cited, 2 exempt, 7 deferred (the face-down Conspiracy draft cards); engine bugs: "If [condition], repeat this process once." after two or more sentences repeated only the last sentence (fixed in the oracle compiler, oracle/patterns/followup_loops.rs; Zimone and Dina, the scheme No Secret Is Hidden from Me), and a damage source selector resolving to several objects had only the first deal damage (resolve.rs DealDamage; Chainer's Torment under Anointed Procession); test errors: 9 CR citations naming a different rule, fixed in review (701.8b for discard, 701.8c for the discarding player's choice, 701.17a for sacrifice, 115.5 for triggered-ability targets, 202.3b for X off the stack, 111.8 and 101.2 not exercised, 508.1c for announcing the attacked planeswalker), plus two misdated CR-history claims in the Souls of the Faultless discrepancy entry corrected; 1 outdated ruling exempted and logged (Souls of the Faultless in Two-Headed Giant), Avatar Aang's airbend ruling noted as not yet investigated, no register entries

mana-value batch (144 of 150 texts cited, 6 deferred: Narod, Sly Spy and two schemes; 0 exempt); engine bugs: a "becomes ... with power and toughness each equal to that spell's mana value" predicate read the affected object's own mana value, so Veiled Sentry became a 1/1 (oracle compiler, becomes_grammar.rs), a discard paid as a cost didn't bind "it", so Argentum Masticore's reflexive trigger never fired (cost_effects.rs), and "if it's a creature card" over several linked exiled cards required all of them (The Creation of Avacyn with a copied chapter I; oracle compiler, conditions_referents.rs); also a "you may cast it" offer no longer names a card that can't be cast (Rashmi revealing Mandate of Peace in a main phase: the card went to hand either way, so not counted as a bug); test errors: 11 CR citations naming a different rule, 5 cited rules the assertions didn't exercise (dropped), 3 given the case that exercises them, 1 assertion that held whichever way the ruling went (Rashmi's "not evoked"); 1 provisional register entry (a-commander-you-own-is-the-greatest), whose rule quote and ruling dates the review corrected; Kellan, the Kid's Cease // Desist cost typo logged as not yet investigated

column4: 66 audit tests (layers.rs, CR 613; all 53 sampled mutants run)
column9: first audit area; 64 of the implementer's 65 tests passed first time and the 65th (Mind Bend on Blood Moon) failed only on a display-only bug: text changes dropped the plural "s" from rules_text (CR 612.1), and the review found and fixed that fix's own defect (Islands became "Plainss" when the replacement was Plains); no layers.rs change was needed and every initial failure the implementer hit was the test's own expectation; the review's 1 new test (Humility, Opalescence and Worship in both orders, the 2009 ruling, CR 613.6) and 2 extended scenarios (Colossus Hammer on Vampire Nocturnus; the Plains plural with Island Fish Jasconius) passed first time; test error: Imprisoned in the Moon cited 205.3d for behavior of 205.1a; rulings cited where the scenario is the ruling (Kwende, Mycosynth Lattice, Colossus Hammer x2); 1 provisional register entry kept (star-without-defining-ability-is-zero: no ruling settles it); 4 deliberate engine breaks each failed only their predicted tests (6, 1, 26 and 4 of 66); mutation 45 caught + 2 timeouts of 53 (88.7%), 6 equivalent survivors

mana-value batch (143 of 150 texts cited, 7 deferred: Gallery of Legends, Animate Spell, Push Your Luck, Feeding Grounds and B-I-N-G-O; 0 exempt, 0 uncovered); engine bugs: an X spell was offered as castable under a prohibition no X could lift (Gaddock Teeg's "{X} in their mana costs"; the review replaced the implementer's structural filter rewrite, which also missed parity filters, with trying the values of X against the check the proposal's legality uses, CR 601.3a), a card with an unpayable mandatory additional cost was offered for a free cast (Bankrupt in Blood with one creature, Electrodominance), a cast trigger's "that much damage" read 0 (Imminent Doom: a cast event's amount is the spell's mana value), a card proposed for casting from the graveyard was counted by its own cost reduction (The Capitoline Triad: the preview said {4}, the cast charged {5}), and (found in review) the implementer's choice-time castability check judged targets as a card was chosen, so a spell cast during the same resolution couldn't target one cast before it (Twincast after Lightning Strike: Plargg and Nassari, Etali, Izzet Chemister, The Great Synthesis; six existing tests); test errors: 14 CR citations naming a different rule or one not exercised (fixed), 1 shared ruling's second wording untested (TARDIS Bay, now with the plane in play), 1 pinned fallback without its register entry (default-damage-assignment); the Capitoline Triad mana-ability ruling had been listed as uncovered for a wrong reason (the planner does activate sacrifice-cost mana abilities) and is now tested with Ashnod's Altar; no exemptions, no register entries

column4: 2 user decisions (D1: Share the Spoils follows its ruling; Stinging Study: the player chooses the commander), 2 register entries decided, 8 tests
column9: Part A: a look-back "loses the game" trigger whose source leaves the game with the loser doesn't trigger (leaves_with_loser.rs, found through looks_back, never by card; register loses-the-game-trigger-leaves-with-the-loser, decided; the Share the Spoils entry left docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md); Part B: Value::OfChosen, the controller picks the object as the effect resolves, validated, default the first candidate (register a-commander-you-own-is-chosen, decided; Stinging Study joins the round trip; the base and branch compilers agree on every other card mentioning "commander"); no engine bug; test errors (review): the choice test cited 608.2c (instructions in order) for a choice made on resolution, which is 608.2d (also misquoted in a module doc and quoted in the register), and the 800.4d test's trigger case used the loser's own Blood Tyrant, which Part A now keeps from triggering before 800.4d applies, so it uses a stolen Tyrant (the loser's trigger by look-back stays off the stack); remaining gap: two OfChosen values in one effect would share one choice (no such card)

mana-value and last-known-information batch (145 of 150 texts cited, 2 exempt: Ulamog, the Defiler's Oracle-update note and Brothers Yamazaki's art note, 2 deferred: Narod, the Beige Flower and A Premonition of Your Demise, 0 uncovered; 1 open conflict case for the coordinator: Sister Hospitaller's "as it last existed in the graveyard" against Cleric Class's "as it exists on battlefield" for the same template, left uncited, with the provisional register entry returned-card-values-current-on-the-battlefield pinned by the Cleric Class test); no engine bug: the implementer's engine change (zones.rs moved_object_lki: last known information for "its" values read through the IT variable after a permanent left the battlefield) was reverted in review, since with origin's eval.rs and zones.rs every P155 test passes (the compiler reads such values through the target slot and the SACRIFICED and DESTROYED variables, which keep the departed object, and rebinds "it" to IT only after a move to the battlefield) and its reported bug didn't reproduce; its register entry dropped; test errors (review): 5 assertions that held whichever way the ruling went (Terminal Velocity's 4/4 victim, Eldritch Evolution's copy case, Sunbird's Invocation's `|| true`, Imskir Iron-Eater not being an artifact, Transmute Artifact finding a {0} card), 6 tests citing 8 rules they don't exercise (615.6, 616.1 and 616.1c for a redirection, 602.2b for "activate only if", 707.12 twice for spell copies, 611.2b, 116.1), and the Cleric Class test pinning the graveyard-return reading without a register entry

self-replacement batch ("instead" clauses; 148 of 150 texts cited, 1 exempt: Forsaken Crossroads's advice to write down the starting player, 1 deferred: Astroquarium, 0 uncovered); engine bug: a taken "you may ... instead" fell back to the instruction it replaces when the replacement did nothing, so Emeria Shepherd put an Aura with nothing to enchant into its owner's hand instead of leaving it in the graveyard (CR 614.6, 303.4g; Condition::PrevChosen at the two compile sites, referents_instead_4.rs and damage_removal_instead.rs; the review records the choice after the offered instruction runs, so a "you may" inside it can't stand in for it, and adds the declined side's test); test errors (review): 28 tests citing a rule their assertions don't exercise or another rule than meant (701.17a mill for sacrifice three times, 701.8b destroy for discard, 701.13a exile for mill, 701.20a reveal for shuffle and search, 701.12b exchange for fight, 707.10b and 707.10e for spell copies, 601.2g for the mana spent, 601.1a twice, 115.5, 118.9a, 508.4, 117.3b twice, 603.10a, 608.2b, 609.4, 305.9, 205.3d, 702.16b, 702.131a, 506.4, 101.4a, 509.1h for a blocker), 6 assertions that held whichever way the ruling went (Ceta Sanctuary's net hand size, The Destined Warrior's once-only reduction on a {1}{R} card, The Final Days' X equal to the two tokens it replaces, the White Mage's target loop with no target offered, Extract a Confession's simultaneity watched on the opponent who chooses first, Forsaken Crossroads's untap without the scry it replaces), 2 claims untested (Goblin Charbelcher's order, Talent of the Telepath declined), 1 custom card where real ones are supported (The Five Doctors), and 1 template error cited without its record: two of The Destined White Mage's rulings call its third ability its "second" (Aerith Gainsborough's ruling with the name swapped), now partly exempt under ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way and logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md; no register entries

column4: 64 audit tests (casting.rs, CR 601–602/118; all 105 sampled mutants run, 84.6% caught, 89.4% after the re-run)
column9: second audit area; the implementer's 56 tests found 4 engine bugs (emerge's reduction applied after Trinisphere's floor, 702.119a/601.2f; the greatest X offered bounded by mana when X is paid with life or cards, 107.3a/119.4; a 'choose one' mana ability in a planned payment taking its first option, 605.3a/601.2g; face-down castability judged by the card's face, 702.37c/708.4) and raised 2 provisional entries (phyrexian-symbol-colored-reduction, keyword-cost-reduction-bounded-by-the-keyword-cost); the review found 2 more bugs (keyword-cost increases and reductions applied in timestamp order, 601.2f, two Catalyst Stones; an agent's absurd count for a repeatable optional cost built the total cost up without bound, found through a casting.rs mutant) and 2 defects in the implementer's own unlanded fixes, not counted (an empty mana hint took the player's choice from a 'choose one' mana ability an effect activated; announced Phyrexian payment ways mis-mapped after a colored reduction); test errors: the Fist of Suns kicker ruling and the Helm 'to zero' ruling cited but not exercised, 118.7a in the Edgewalker and Training Grounds/Suppression Field tests, 602.5b in the Wall of Roots test, Drana's 118.7a not biting; 8 deliberate engine breaks each failed only their predicted tests; mutation: 105 sampled mutants all run, 87 caught + 1 timeout (84.6%), 16 survivors: 11 equivalent or dead paths, 5 killed by tests written during the review (cascade option labels, a face-down card exiled with a play permission isn't a land to play, a negative multikicker count, Moxite Refinery's least-payable default X, the 30-life Toxic Deluge bound), all confirmed by the re-run (89.4%); one more review test (Calciform Pools, X beyond the counters) exercises a check the payment code repeats

column4: 1 user decision (keyword cost reductions on an alternative cost come off after the cost increases, CR 118.9d/601.2f; 21 alternative-cost keywords), 3 register entries (1 decided, 2 provisional), 8 new or rewritten tests and 1 extended; 3 deliberate engine breaks
column9: kw::set_alternative_keyword_cost puts the keyword's increases on the alternative cost and its reduction among the total cost's reductions (CastOption::alt_cost_reduction); buyback and morph face-up keep the bounded modified_keyword_cost; engine bug (pre-existing, fixed by the restructure, pinned by the review): the old keyword reduction was built before X was announced, so Catalyst Stone never reduced an X in a flashback cost (Devil's Play, 107.3a/601.2f); the review split the register entry: the implementer had marked decided both the buyback half (still the user's open question, now provisional keyword-cost-reduction-on-an-additional-cost-within-it) and its own extension that an alternative-keyword reduction also comes off additional costs paid with it (Capsize given flashback with buyback, a commander tax, kicker; now provisional alternative-keyword-cost-reduction-reduces-additional-costs); test errors: the Warbringer 'dash cost includes one generic mana' ruling and 118.7a cited in the dash test but not exercised (no scenario without an increase); review tests: X in a flashback cost (Devil's Play with Lodestone Golem), Trinisphere's floor after the reduction, Henzie's per-commander-cast blitz reduction (its unexercised structure); the 3 engine breaks (the old bounded reading, the reduction after Trinisphere's floor, the reduction applied twice) each failed only their predicted tests

repeatable impulse draw batch (149 of 150 texts cited, 0 exempt, 0 deferred, 0 uncovered; 1 open conflict case for the coordinator: Headliner Scarlett's "Once the turn ends, you can't look at or play the card exiled with Headliner Scarlett that turn. It remains face down in exile, and no one can look at it." (2024-02-02) against CR 406.3's "once a player is allowed to look at a card exiled face down, that player may continue to look at that card until it leaves the exile zone ... even if the instruction allowing the player to do so no longer applies" (in substance in every archived CR since 2016-01-16, reworded 2023-06-16, in force on the ruling's date), left uncited; the engine follows 406.3, pinned by tests/cards/permission_scopes.rs); engine bugs: cards exiled "until" something happens were one batch of events, so "whenever one or more cards are put into exile" triggered once, where Laelia, the Blade Reforged's ruling (2024-06-07) has them exiled one at a time: cascade, discover and the RevealUntil exile form (implementer: Game::one_at_a_time_step, regression test with Bloodbraid Elf, Geological Appraiser and Solstice Revelations), and (found in review) the dig-step forms ("until you exile two nonland cards", "cards with total mana value 4 or greater", "X permanent cards": Improvisation Capstone, Invasion of Alara, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, Dream Harvest, Auspicious Starrix); ruling-backed (the CR is silent), no register entry; each call site was removed in turn and the test failed; misattached rulings: Traveling Minister carries Undead Butler's (implementer, logged), Mount Doom Moria Marauder's (review: cited at origin under Moria Marauder, unlogged until now); test errors (review): 13 tests citing 16 rules they don't exercise (610.3, 611.2b twice, 406.3, 603.4, 608.2h, 608.2c for a choice made on resolution, 701.14b for a fight, the 205.3 heading, 307.1, 608.2b twice, 113.7a, 118.3 twice, 121.3), Ral's coin-flip test checking that no priority decision came up in TestGame::resolve (which never asks for one), Sanar's X check that held for X = 2 and 3 (revealed cards are shuffled back), the rulings' "while the stack is empty" untested in the 38-card table's timing helpers and in Ral's -8 test, Vance's Blasting Cannons' "resolves before the spell" unasserted, Elkin Bottle's "until the beginning of your next upkeep" after the Bottle leaves untested, and Mount Doom's misattached ruling without its record; no exemptions, no register entries

column4: 81 audit tests (triggers.rs, CR 603; 17 of 55 sampled mutants reached when landed, 82.4% caught)
column9: third audit area; the implementer's 74 tests found 3 engine bugs (a 'one or more' leaves-the-battlefield ability its permanent lost because of the event didn't look back, 603.10a; an ability triggering on 'a permanent entering causes a triggered ability to trigger' compared the other ability's whole trigger condition, so 'enters or attacks', 'enters or is put into a graveyard' and 'enters, if' abilities never counted, 603.2/603.6a; 'whenever an opponent gains control of a permanent from you' on a permanent taken at the same time as others was given to the new controller for the others' changes, 603.10d) and raised no register entry; the review found 1 more bug (Teysa Karlov dying with the creatures didn't double a 'one or more creatures die' ability: the batch path counted the 'triggers an additional time' effects after the event, 603.2d/603.10a) and 2 defects in the implementer's own unlanded fix, not counted (a reflexive ability inherited its parent's event kind, so Strict Proctor countered Intrepid Adversary's 'When you pay this cost', 603.12; 'enters from a graveyard' abilities were still missed, the cause matched against the card as it last was in the graveyard), and registered the fix's reading as provisional entry ability-triggered-cause-is-the-event (a 'leaves your graveyard' ability on a reanimation counts; Jailbreak's reflexive 'When that permanent enters' doesn't, a recorded limitation); test errors: the implementer's 4 (tokens named 'Spirit' not 'Spirit Token' in 3 tests, Desecrated Tomb's Relic exiled as a cost, Mesmeric Orb past the upkeep, Intrepid Adversary's extra yes/no) and the review's 1 (Grafted Exoskeleton's unattach ruling cited for one of the five ways it lists; the test now covers four); the review added 7 tests (Strict Proctor with a reflexive ability and with an enters-from-a-graveyard ability, Teysa dying with a one-or-more ability, Switcheroo with Zidane, an ability gained because of the event, Khârn taken with others, Commandeer on Through the Breach) and extended 4; 10 deliberate engine breaks each failed only their predicted tests (31, 1, 4, 4, 1, 5, 2, 1 and 1 of 79), except disabling the later-batch filter (born_later), which failed none of them (Living Death's steps are checked one at a time; the suite's Endless Swarm ruling test pins it and caught mutant 226:56); mutation: 17 of 55 sampled mutants reached when landed, 14 caught (82.4%), 3 equivalent survivors, 38 remaining (one of them, 2169:33, killed by a review test checked with the mutant applied)
